headline: Göyçay: foothills district with high school density and low paved roads share

tags.reason: There are 7.1 schools per 10,000 residents, compared to the national median of 4.14.
The area features 3.01 parks per 10,000 residents and a PM2.5 model value of 14.1.

summary: Göyçay has a population of 119,700 and a density of 162 residents per km². The tehsil index is 76, which is higher than the national median of 53. The neqliyyat index stands at 56 against the national median of 47. However, the paved roads share is only 2.1%, while the national median is 4.35%.
strengths: School coverage is high with 7.1 schools per 10,000 residents (national median 4.14).
Kindergarten provision is 1.09 per 10,000 residents (national median 0.47).
University facilities reach 0.75 per 10,000 residents (national median 0.03).
weaknesses: Paved roads cover only 2.1% of known surfaces (national median 4.35%).
Surface unknown percentage reaches 72.1% across the district road network.
The tebiet index is 25, lower than the national median of 51.
best_for: Families requiring educational facilities due to high school and kindergarten counts.
Residents seeking a foothills environment with 3.01 parks per 10,000 residents.
watch_out: Very low paved road share of 2.1% on known surfaces.
High unknown road surface share of 72.1% across 1847 total km of roads.
Absence of price listings and property data in the dataset.
confidence_note: OSM coverage is high and per capita metrics are reliable, but price data is completely absent and listed as none.
